text:
maria: quick note — ran bring-up bench for new ranker (3B-ft) across float32 vs int8. overall NDCG@10 for int8 is +0.018 vs float but MRR@1 drops by -0.047. weird split: short queries gain, long queries lose.

devon: did you use the same candidate ordering between runs? that can flip ndcg/mrr if ties reorder.

maria: i fixed seed but i realized our candidate pool was sorted by retrieval_score in float run and by doc_id in int8 run (shuffled earlier in pipeline). oops.

aj: ah that explains a lot — ndcg is more tolerant to reordering than top1, so MRR could tank. can you re-run with canonical ordering?

maria: re-ran with explicit sort by retrieval_score, seed kept the same. new numbers: float32 MRR@1=0.421, NDCG@10=0.612; int8 MRR@1=0.418, NDCG@10=0.630. int8 still higher on ndcg but MRR gap now -0.003.

samir: interesting that quant helps ndcg but not top1. maybe quantization smooths score distribution so tail docs move up slightly, improving ndcg which averages deep ranks. top1 needs strict calibration.

maria: i dug into score histograms — int8 logits have lower variance (std dev ~0.87 vs 1.1). here's the eval command and minimal config i used:

```
python eval_reranker.py \
  --model checkpoints/3b-ft \
  --quant int8 \
  --dataset holdout_v2.jsonl \
  --candidate-order retrieval_score \
  --seed 42 \
  --metrics mrr@1 ndcg@5 ndcg@10
```

maria: sample of per-query diffs (short/long split):
- qlen<=8: mean delta NDCG@10 = +0.035, MRR@1 = +0.006
- qlen>32: mean delta NDCG@10 = -0.012, MRR@1 = -0.022

devon: did you normalize/document length truncation? int8 path may accidentally truncate earlier if tokenization pipeline differs.

maria: tokenization identical AFAICT. i did find we accidentally applied a 512 token truncation earlier for int8 model due to a config key mismatch (max_seq_len vs cutoff_len). fixed and re-run; numbers changed slightly but overall pattern holds.

aj: can you dump one or two failure cases (queries where float top1 is correct and int8 is wrong) and we can eyeball? also run temperature calibration / score scaling post-quant to see if MRR recovers.

maria: dropping 3 failures in /tmp/failures_int8_v_float.jsonl. one example: query 'how to set up oauth for my app' — float top1 is an authoritative doc, int8 moved another doc to top because its score was +0.02 higher after quant.

samir: i recommend adding a small isotonic regression or a learned bias term per-batch to re-calibrate logits post-quant for production. for evals we should also report score variance and tie counts.

maria: noted. i'll run a small calibration sweep (scale and shift) and post results tomorrow. also thinking about adding a 'stable_sort' enforced in the bring-up checklist to avoid candidate-order artifacts.

eval-bot: scheduled re-run with calibration sweep at 02:00 UTC, job id eb-3151122. monitoring will push metrics to /dash/rerank/3b-ft/bringup.

devon: thanks — appreciate the clear thread. low-effort checklist additions make these bring-ups less noisy. :thumbsup:
